csv_project_name: CMAR Service for COM Building Infrastructure Project
csv_scope_of_work: Johnson County Community College intends to contract for Construction Manager at Risk (CMAR) Services for infrastructure improvements projects on JCCC s Commons Building (COM) and Office and Classroom Building (OCB). The College will utilize the AIA A133-2019 Standard Form of Agreement Between Owner and Construction Manager as Constructor as modified by JCCC. Anticipated construction cost for these projects is approximately $9 million. JCCC, at its sole discretion, may use the selected Construction Manager for additional building upgrades that are not directly associated with the listed projects. All projects are contingent upon the College securing sufficient public and/or private financing to pay for design, development, construction and renovations. The architect of record on these projects is BBN Architects for COM and Clark & Enersen for OCB
